subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should Control UI adopt Gateway `inFlightRun`/active-run snapshots after a WebSocket reconnect, or is the narrower current session/history/event recovery behavior the intended contract?
rationale: The current code has partial recovery mechanisms but no proven end-to-end fix for this report, and the permanent contract affects Gateway payloads, Control UI state, and the linked recovery PR direction.

options.title: Adopt active-run snapshots
options.body: Implement Control UI recovery from Gateway active-run/in-flight data and require live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Revive the linked recovery PR
options.body: Ask the PR author or a maintainer to rebase, narrow, and prove the existing recovery PR before using it as the canonical fix path.

options.title: Accept narrower recovery
options.body: Document that current history/session/event recovery is sufficient and close only after maintainer confirmation and live proof that active runs no longer terminate.

recommendation.title: Adopt active-run snapshots
recommendation.body: Implement Control UI recovery from Gateway active-run/in-flight data and require live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame places the inspected active-run and Control UI chat lifecycle lines under this recent area contributor, making them the best available owner for the contract decision.
